checks: 11 owned unit checks and6 fake-process integration checks, twice debug/release (see retained named outcomes)
Six compiled production mutations, nonzero test exits and exact restoration
cost: B bytes, R requests, P partial rows, N tokens: prompt/serialization O(B), map operations logarithmic, partial request matching O(P*R), plus delegated expert/gate/training/transport work. No runtime speed or remote-cost estimate.
description: Draft Ann/Item -> optional repair/hints -> llm prompt blocks -> batch request/state -> codex snapshot+partial queue -> batch reply parsing -> main Outcome patch/blind gates -> finish files/report and optional corpus. Only the bounded pure/helper and fake-process prefix is executed.
forward: Draft Ann/Item -> optional repair/hints -> llm prompt blocks -> batch request/state -> codex snapshot+partial queue -> batch reply parsing -> main Outcome patch/blind gates -> finish files/report and optional corpus. Only the bounded pure/helper and fake-process prefix is executed.

ann.rs is an existing cross-group gate/type dependency, not duplicate ownership. main and batch share Outcome::add_patch_reply/finish; llm direct fixed+variable concatenation differs by two separating newlines from codex message-block join. hints advise only; repair precedes draft gates; optional post-gate FEATS replacement is not re-gated.
Bounded packet packing and immutable page supervision distinguish source-ID intent accounting from Task jobs and actual validated model reviews.
inverse: Unknown reply ids, missing/broken/gate-failed patches do not become accepted final annotations. Queue rejects sticky failures before launch, but existing final sentinel bypasses validation. No inference from fake success to live quality.

Final Ann admits many draft/patch antecedents; result envelopes admit overwritten duplicates/discarded thinking. Queue final permits fresh or resumed execution histories; source state and prompt are not uniquely recoverable.
limitations: No end-to-end training or finish/API execution
No executable percent surrogate; 1/2/5/10% metric unsupported
Duplicate ids and invalid state indexing remain explicit assumptions
Cache/source provenance and source ownership are separately supplied by a private caller; page completion can include explicit deferrals and quarantines.
state: Unique ids, consistent forms and in-range state indices are required at adapters. Accepted patch outputs pass existing ann::check. Queue final name follows all local successes under immutable inputs/single worker; finish is not transactional.
